risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (291.5) indicates extreme market stress, rising DXY pressures financials, and credit spreads likely elevated; earnings in 53 days adds event risk but secondary to acute macro deterioration.

debate.key_bull_argument: Early MACD/StochRSI crossovers with OBV strength and extreme fear (VIX crisis) create contrarian reversal setup near support (88.83), offering asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Inverted yield curve, VIX at crisis levels, DXY headwinds, price below all key moving averages, weak ADX trend structure, zero fundamental catalysts, and 53-day earnings event risk make this a macro-driven bear market where technical bounces fail—wait for macro confirmation.
